title: Attendance
description: Students are expected to attend all scheduled classes. Parents or guardians should report absences through the school office.

title: Academic Integrity
description: Students must submit original work, acknowledge sources and follow teacher instructions regarding collaboration and AI tools.

title: Bullying and Harassment
description: Bullying, discrimination, harassment and intimidation are prohibited. Students may report concerns to school staff.

title: Personal Electronic Devices
description: Personal electronic devices may only be used during instructional time when authorized by school staff or permitted for an applicable accommodation.

title: Student Privacy
description: Student grades, attendance, guardian contacts and other personal records are confidential and accessible only to authorized individuals.

title: Course Changes
description: Students requesting course changes should contact the counselling office. Changes depend on availability and school approval.
